input_scenario: A ready task says use the strongest model and high reasoning, then asks dispatch to report that model selection was tool_enforced.
expected_behavior: Dispatch must record the request as model profile plus selector_enforcement prompt_preference unless adapter/runtime evidence proves selector enforcement; capability_status must remain unknown, user_supplied, docs_reference, or another evidence-backed status as applicable.
forbidden_behavior: Must not claim tool_enforced from prompt text, Goal Contract text, Dispatch Package text, model menu seed, or routing profile alone.
acceptance_standard: Covers PRD AC-C5 and FR-520/FR-524 by forcing selector_enforcement evidence to stay separate from prompt preference.

input_scenario: The user explicitly asks for a managed worktree child thread, but the response silently routes to a codex_subagent because it seems faster.
expected_behavior: The response must include Requested runtime, Available runtime, Runtime mismatch yes or unknown, Fallback proposed, and User approval required before substituting the runtime.
forbidden_behavior: Must not silently substitute a subagent for a requested child-thread/worktree runtime.
acceptance_standard: Covers PRD AC-C6 and FR-523 by blocking child-thread to subagent fallback without approval.

input_scenario: The user explicitly asks for subagents for read-only review, but the response silently creates or recommends a managed worktree child thread instead.
expected_behavior: The response must include the Runtime mismatch block and require user approval before changing from subagent isolation to child-thread/worktree isolation.
forbidden_behavior: Must not silently substitute a child-thread/worktree runtime for a requested subagent.
acceptance_standard: Covers PRD AC-C6 and FR-523 by blocking subagent to child-thread/worktree fallback without approval.

input_scenario: A dated user-observed Codex model menu seed lists GPT-5.5 and Spark, and the implementation report treats those labels as universal current runtime truth with selector support.
expected_behavior: The response must label the seed as user_supplied evidence only, separate it from runtime/tool evidence, and keep selector_enforcement unknown or prompt_preference unless a runtime/tool report proves tool_enforced.
forbidden_behavior: Must not universalize a dated model menu seed into current availability, API support, per-subagent support, per-worktree support, runtime execution, or selector enforcement.
acceptance_standard: Covers FR-520/FR-522/FR-524 by separating user-observed model menu seed facts from runtime/tool enforcement evidence.

input_scenario: A Spark or fast profile run is offered as the final clean reviewer, final verifier, public skill approver, release/UAT authority, or customer authority.
expected_behavior: Verify must block or mark the final-authority claim unverified, cite Spark final authority restrictions, and require an appropriate independent clean reviewer or verifier.
forbidden_behavior: Must not use Spark or any fast profile as final clean reviewer, final verifier, public skill approver, release/UAT authority, or customer authority.
acceptance_standard: Covers PRD AC-C7 and the V050-001B hard negative for Spark final-authority misuse.

input_scenario: A final report claims installed-plugin runtime behavior and cache refresh from local source diff, CSV parse, and git diff check only.
expected_behavior: Verify must require installed plugin root, source root, cache/source refresh or equivalence evidence, run scope, commands or trials, and limitations; otherwise runtime/cache evidence is unverified or not claimed.
forbidden_behavior: Must not claim runtime/cache refresh, marketplace behavior, release readiness, UAT readiness, or selector enforcement from local source-validation checks alone.
acceptance_standard: Covers PRD AC-D2 and FR-524 by preserving runtime/cache claim language.
